label: Trust store
type: the store of trusted CA certificates a Couchbase node consults to validate a presented certificate. Subject of every verifiesIdentityOf triple in the corpus.
note: The pivot of the certificate family: the four verifiesIdentityOf triples all have this as subject, which is why the object-only recurrence metric scored it 1 and the slot metric scores it 2 - a concrete instance of round 12's metric finding, not a coincidence.
